title: The month onion prices fell across India
summary: In May 2020, the median onion market moved -31.2% in a month, 3.8 standard deviations from the usual for that month.
why_selected: Chosen automatically: the 3.8σ seasonal move is among the largest on record for onion, across 495 reporting markets.

evidence.observations: monthly medians of daily modal prices; markets need ≥5 reports in both months
caveats: Many market points are district centres, not mandi gates.
Modal prices are reported aggregates, not transaction offers.

scenes.headline: May 2020
scenes.caption: Onion prices across 495 markets that reported in both April 2020 and May 2020.

scenes.headline: Median move -31.2%
scenes.caption: The typical market's onion price fell 31.2% in one month. 100% of markets moved the same way.

scenes.headline: 3.8× the usual swing
scenes.caption: Compared with the same month in every earlier year on record, this move was 3.8 standard deviations from normal.

scenes.headline: Haryana
scenes.caption: Neighbouring markets moved together: the 36 reporting markets in Haryana had a median change of -43.5%.

scenes.headline: Barwala
scenes.caption: Barwala (Haryana), one of the busiest markets among the biggest movers: monthly median ₹1,700 → ₹900 per quintal (-47.1%).

scenes.headline: What this does and doesn't show
scenes.caption: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.

conclusion: These are reported wholesale modal prices, not causes. Weather, arrivals or policy may explain the move, but this story shows only what markets reported.
